sparks.text: If your week were a weather forecast, what would it be?
What's a small thing that made you smile this week?
What's the most useless talent you have?
Which fictional character would be the worst roommate?
Describe your morning using only three emojis.
What's a food you loved as a kid that you'd still defend today?
What's one tool or habit that quietly saves you an hour a week?
If our family had a theme song, what would it be?
You can instantly master one skill. Which one, and why not something useful?
What's the best piece of advice you ignored?
Would you rather always be 10 minutes late or always 20 minutes early?
Would you rather talk to animals or speak every human language?
Would you rather have unlimited coffee or unlimited naps?
I told my computer I needed a break. It said: "No problem, I'll go to sleep."
Why don't eggs tell jokes? They'd crack each other up.
Our team meeting could have been an email. Our email could have been a sticky note. Our sticky note is now this meeting.
What do you call a fake noodle? An impasta.
There are 10 kinds of people: those who understand binary and those who don't.
Why did the scarecrow get promoted? He was outstanding in his field.
I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. I can't put it down.
My plants and I have an understanding: I forget to water them, they forgive me, nobody talks about it.
What has keys but can't open locks? (A piano.)
